title: <tool> doctor --json
description: SPEC §1 `doctor`: one entry per check, in the order printed. `ok` is false, and the exit code 1, if any check failed; warnings don't change either.

id.description: Stable, for scripts. The spec's own: node-engines, install-method, unit, running-version, port, linger, data-home, update. A tool's own checks use their own ids.

status.description: ✓, !, ✗; skip for a check that doesn't apply (linger off Linux, update with --offline).

fix.description: What to do about it. Every fail has one.
